certificate.statement: every emitted vector v=(x,y) satisfies y == A^T x (mod q), i.e. lies in the dual lattice L
certificate.method: integer arithmetic on numpy int64 from A and the reconstructed lattice vectors, independent of g6k's internal representation
certificate.solve_claim_certificate: none -- this run claims no discrete-log solve and no factor-base relation. certificate.kind is lattice_membership only; it certifies the vectors, not any inference from their scores.

independent_identity_check.statement: x.b - y.c == x.e + y.(s-c) (mod q) recomputed by two different routes for all 34 candidates x 17919 vectors

headline_observations.note: Observations only. This receipt states no conclusion about whether the heuristic is validated or refuted.
headline_observations.ingredient_1_per_vector_advantage: HOLDS. Global ratio measured/predicted 0.9838 +/- 0.2148 (2000 draws); common-mode-removed shape ratio 1.0175 .. 0.9804 across a 3.8x range of ||x||^2, monotone (corr -0.9975). Post-hoc D1: using the exact characteristic function of the actual discretised error moves the ratios to 1.00045 .. 1.00327 and shrinks the shape residual 2.8x. Replicated: 0.98771 +/- 0.00968 across 9 further instances.
headline_observations.ingredient_2_uniform_group: HOLDS. sd across 16 uniform candidates 0.005184 vs iid prediction 0.005282; raw ratio 0.9814 +/- 0.1780, 0.9978 after correcting the c4(16) sample-sd bias. Replicated: 1.00207 +/- 0.05209 across 9 further instances.
headline_observations.ingredient_2_secret_distribution_group: DEPARTS as expected. Centred at +0.2816 not 0, and 4.10x wider than iid; both follow from the retained y.(s-c) term (a_y = 0.1586).
headline_observations.ingredient_2_near_miss_group: DEPARTS. 0.1503x the iid spread, i.e. 6.7x MORE concentrated than independence predicts. Paired delta correct minus best-of-8 +0.001523 +/- 0.000719 (per-draw t 2.12); P(correct first) 0.986 over 2000 draws; replicated across 9 further instances with delta 0.001571 +/- 0.000043.
headline_observations.vector_null: CONTROLLED NULL. Sieve database sd 0.088015 (N_eff 44.4) vs random directions of matched ||x|| sd 0.087785 (N_eff 44.7) on PAIRED error draws -- agreement to 0.3%. NULL-IID restores exact iid behaviour (N_eff 18319 vs N 17919). N_eff grows ~linearly in m (44.9/93.8/173.8/349.7 at m 35/70/140/280) and is independent of N (42.2/44.0/40.6/43.8 at N 1000/5000/17919/60000). A modeled analytic sd derived in this task, S*a_x*sqrt(2/m), matches to 1-3% at every m.
